reply.answer_text: A periodic charge applies at the 10-year anniversary on the amount by which the trust property exceeds the nil-rate band. With £425,000 in the trust and full NRB of £325,000 available, the charge is assessed on £100,000. The actual rate is 30% multiplied by the effective rate (20% tax on the excess divided by total property), which gives an effective rate of 4.706% and an actual rate of 1.412%. The resulting charge is approximately £6,000. This uses the formal HMRC settlement-rate computation — the precise figure depends on the exact property value at the anniversary and how the available NRB is applied to your trust's facts.
